xmldoc.short_description: Create a figure configured for building a user interface.

param_input_item.param_description: name-value pairs applied to the figure.

param_output_item.param_description: figure object, meant as the parent of UI components.

description.p: uifigure creates a figure set up to host a user interface instead of a plot. It is a figure with these defaults: no menu bar and no tool bar (MenuBar and ToolBar are 'none'), no number in the title (NumberTitle is 'off'), a handle that is hidden and not an integer (HandleVisibility and IntegerHandle are 'off'), children that resize with the window (AutoResizeChildren is 'on'), a light grey background and a default Position of [488 242 560 420].

Add components to it with uicontrol, uipanel, uibutton and the other ui functions, and open dialogs such as uialert or uiconfirm on it. A figure property given as a name-value pair overrides the matching default; passing Position, InnerPosition or OuterPosition keeps the position you set.

example_item.example_item_description: A UI figure holding a button.
